# pidginhost_bucket (Data Source)

Looks up an existing bucket by `id` or `name` (exactly one).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_bucket" "backups" {
  name = "backups"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Bucket ID.
- `name` (String) Bucket name (as given at creation) or full name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation time.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint URL.
- `full_name` (String) Full bucket name to use with S3 clients.
- `object_count` (Number) Number of objects.
- `public_read` (Boolean) Whether anonymous read access is allowed.
- `quota_gb` (Number) Storage quota in GB.
- `region` (String) S3 region.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Bytes stored.
